arguments.code:
# Compress each vacation spot sub-directory into ~/photographs/vacations/<spot>.zip,
# then delete the original sub-directories.

# Login to file_system
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pw = [p['password'] for p in pw_list if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_email = 'nicholas.weber@gmail.com'

login_resp = apis.file_system.login(username=fs_email, password=fs_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Find vacation spot directories
subdirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/photographs/vacations', access_token=access_token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('vacation spot directories:', subdirs)

spots = [d.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1] for d in subdirs]
print('vacation spots:', spots)

results = []
for spot, dir_abs in zip(spots, subdirs):
    dir_abs = dir_abs.rstrip('/')
    zip_path = f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip'
    # ensure parent dir exists (should already)
    # compress
    comp = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        directory_path=dir_abs,
        access_token=access_token,
        compressed_file_path=zip_path,
        delete_directory=False,
        overwrite=False
    )
    print('compress result for', spot, '->', comp)
    results.append((spot, dir_abs, zip_path, comp))

# Delete original directories after successful compress calls
for spot, dir_abs in zip(spots, subdirs):
    dir_abs = dir_abs.rstrip('/')
    del_resp = apis.file_system.delete_directory(directory_path=dir_abs, access_token=access_token)
    print('deleted', spot, 'resp:', del_resp)

# Verify no sub-directories remain
remaining_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/photographs/vacations', access_token=access_token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('remaining vacation sub-directories:', remaining_dirs)

# Verify zip files exist
zip_files = []
for spot in spots:
    zp = f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip'
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=zp, access_token=access_token)
    print('zip exists?', spot, zp, exists)
    zip_files.append((spot, zp, exists))

print('done')
